prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — Sun Quan of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG 3D key art — a semi-realistic 3D beauty with a small refined face and delicate realistic-anime features, porcelain skin with a soft glow, extremely ornate engraved armour and jewellery with glossy highlights, a strong rim light and drifting light particles, a luxurious promotional finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a walled garden with a lotus pond, a zigzag stone bridge and a small open pavilion
Outfit: an off-shoulder knit top slipping from one shoulder over shorts — in clean neutrals such as white, ivory, oatmeal or soft grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: lying on her side.
SUPPORT: she lies on her side, supported along her hip and shoulder.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right arm bends behind her head, the hand cradling the back of her head, her elbow raised beside her head.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is planted on the ground beside her.
LEGS: legs bent together to one side.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: a small closed-lip smile that reaches the eyes.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most the one small accessory below.

Her legend — striking deep indigo-blue eyes and dark violet-red hair (her legendary 'blue eyes and purple beard'), steady judgment and trust in her ministers, a fearless tiger hunter, holding the Yangtze against two empires — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Accessory: off duty she carries no weapon or armour — her signature weapon (an imperial jian sword with a red tassel) appears only as a pair of drop earrings modelled on its shape and colours, a few centimetres long, clearly jewellery.

Light: the place's own light, with a strong soft rim light tracing her hair and shoulders, glossy highlights on skin and jewellery and drifting light particles — a luxurious promotional glow.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
